purpose: Preserve the original input protocol chain for the imported G-Eval evaluations.
relationship_to_main_experiments: This cohort predates the curated 229-case gold corpus. Evaluation inputs remain in source_protocols rather than being substituted with the later experiments.

source_matching.comparison: Saved G-Eval protocol word counts match the selected historical source protocols in every case.

network_requirement: Generation and judging notebooks require new API credentials. The saved evaluations and their summaries can be inspected offline.
